units.source_text: 众侍女禀告大女公子：“新婚第三夜应请吃饼。”

en.t: The waiting women informed the elder young lady, "On the third night after the wedding, rice cakes should be served."

units.source_text: 大女公子觉得应该郑重举办这祝仪，便亲自出来筹划。

en.t: The elder young lady felt that this congratulatory rite ought to be carried out with proper ceremony, so she came out herself to make the arrangements.
But she did not know how it should be done.

units.source_text: 而且女儿家装作长辈，出来照料此种事情，

en.t: Moreover, for a young woman to act like an elder and come forward to oversee such matters,

units.source_text: 深恐别人见笑，因此红晕满颊，样子实甚可爱。

en.t: made her deeply afraid that others would laugh at her; her cheeks flushed red, and she looked truly charming.

units.source_text: 她的态度优雅而高尚，慈祥而和蔼，

en.t: Her manner was graceful and noble, kindly and gentle,

units.source_text: 对人富有同情，毕竟是具有大姐心肠之故吧。

en.t: and she was full of sympathy for others; this was, after all, because she had the heart of an elder sister.
